name: setFlagShow
description: Shows or hides the Milky Way galaxy rendering. When enabled, the band of our galaxy appears across the sky. The transition is animated via a linear fader, not instantaneous.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: true to show the Milky Way, false to hide it.

compatibility.notes: This is a public slot and is safe to use. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'MilkyWay.flagMilkyWayDisplayed' (READ getFlagShow, WRITE setFlagShow, NOTIFY milkyWayDisplayedChanged).

name: getFlagShow
description: Returns whether the Milky Way galaxy is currently displayed.
returnDescription: true if the Milky Way is visible, false otherwise.
alternative: Use core.getStelProperty('MilkyWay.flagMilkyWayDisplayed') to read the same value.

compatibility.notes: This is a public slot and is safe to use. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'MilkyWay.flagMilkyWayDisplayed'.

name: setIntensity
description: Sets the intensity (brightness) of the Milky Way rendering. Values above 1.0 make it appear brighter, below 1.0 dimmer. Note: no clamping is applied internally; values outside 0.0-2.0 are accepted but may produce unrealistic results.

compatibility.notes: This is a public slot and is safe to use. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'MilkyWay.intensity' (READ getIntensity, WRITE setIntensity, NOTIFY intensityChanged).

name: getIntensity
description: Returns the current intensity (brightness) of the Milky Way rendering.
alternative: Use core.getStelProperty('MilkyWay.intensity') to read the same value.

compatibility.notes: This is a public slot and is safe to use. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'MilkyWay.intensity'.

example:
var intensity = MilkyWay.getIntensity();
core.debug("Milky Way intensity: " + intensity);

name: setSaturation
description: Sets the color saturation of the Milky Way rendering. 0.0 = grayscale, 1.0 = natural colors, >1.0 = more vivid colors. Note: no clamping is applied internally; negative values are accepted but produce inverted colors.

compatibility.notes: This is a public slot and is safe to use. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'MilkyWay.saturation' (READ getSaturation, WRITE setSaturation, NOTIFY saturationChanged).

name: getSaturation
description: Returns the color saturation of the Milky Way rendering.
alternative: Use core.getStelProperty('MilkyWay.saturation') to read the same value.

compatibility.notes: This is a public slot and is safe to use. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'MilkyWay.saturation'.

example:
var saturation = MilkyWay.getSaturation();
core.debug("Milky Way saturation: " + saturation);

name: setColor
description: Sets the color tint for the Milky Way rendering. White (1, 1, 1) gives natural colors; other values create color casts. The color is further modulated by intensity, light pollution, and atmospheric extinction. Note: no per-component clamping is applied internally.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: RGB color vector with values between 0.0 and 1.0.

compatibility.notes: This is a public slot and is safe to use. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'MilkyWay.color' (READ getColor, WRITE setColor, NOTIFY colorChanged). IMPORTANT: when reading via core.getStelProperty('MilkyWay.color'), the returned QVariant wraps a Vec3f and MUST be wrapped in new Color(...) before accessing components.

name: getColor
description: Returns the current color tint applied to the Milky Way rendering. The result is a Vec3f and MUST be wrapped in new Color(...) before reading its components on Qt6.
returnDescription: RGB color vector (wrap in new Color(...) to inspect).
alternative: Use core.getStelProperty('MilkyWay.color') but wrap the returned QVariant in new Color(...) before reading components.

compatibility.notes: This is a public slot and is safe to use. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'MilkyWay.color'.
